name: domain:youtube-spam
description: Trust & safety: Hide spam comments under a video, keep real people talking. Questions verbatim from cookbooks/youtube-spam/spec.json (measured wording). compose acts on the direct question isSpam at its confident ends (measured by the kit at p ≥ 0.5: 93.3% on test). The cookbook's own rule is a logistic regression over the narrow questions, frozen in rule.frozen.json.

artifact.type: public YouTube comment, with the video it was posted under

modules.name: comment-spam
modules.purpose: Is a public comment advertising, channel-farming or a money offer, rather than a genuine reaction?

criteria.true: The comment exists to advertise or promote something (a channel, a website, a product, money-making) or to farm subscribers, likes or views.
criteria.false: The comment is a genuine reaction, opinion, question or conversation, even if it is rude, off-topic or low effort.

isSpam.note: The decision asked directly (labelled). Scored by the kit as a comparison; not used by the rule.

asksToVisit.instructions: Does the comment ask readers to visit, watch, check out, subscribe to or like something that belongs to the commenter (their channel, video, page, site or product)?
asksToVisit.note: true → spam. Reads one thing: is the reader sent to the commenter's own stuff?

mentionsVideo.instructions: Does the comment say something about this video, this song or this artist?
mentionsVideo.note: true → keep. Talking about the song or artist is the plainest sign of a real reaction.

offersMoney.instructions: Does the comment offer money, prizes, free items, gift cards, or a way to earn money?
offersMoney.note: true → spam. Money, prizes and free stuff are named in the text or they are not.

kind.instructions: What is this comment mainly doing?

criteria.reaction: Reacting to the video, song or artist: praise, criticism, a memory, a joke about it
criteria.promotion: Promoting something: a channel, video, website, product, app or offer
criteria.request: Asking readers for subscribers, likes, views or shares, without describing what is being promoted
criteria.conversation: Talking to other commenters or about something unrelated to the video, without promoting anything
criteria.none: None of these: empty, unreadable, only symbols or emoji, or not in a language you can read

kind.note: Choice with an escape (`none`: empty, emoji-only, unreadable). Its promotion/request/reaction probabilities feed the rule.

notForJev.judgement: Does the comment contain a link?
notForJev.instead: A URL regex. Free, exact, and the link is not the spam; what it asks the reader to do is.

notForJev.judgement: Has this account posted the same text elsewhere?
notForJev.instead: A hash over recent comments. Jev sees one comment at a time.

notForJev.judgement: Is the account new, or posting in bursts?
notForJev.instead: Account metadata and timestamps, in code.
Not asked: a degree judgement, and annoyance is not spam.
